output.title: BR-04 printed USD lines add up to the subtotal, each line rounded in the invoice currency before tax @critical
output.data_choice: P-1130 is the only free project with several converted lines: USD at 1.0835, 8 h SNR, 8 h CONS and 2.1 h CONS, with standard tax S. As seeded, its unrounded remainders (0, 0 and 0.002 USD) are too small to show the defect. Two write-ups of +0.05 EUR take the remainders to 0.004175, 0.004175 and 0.002. The rounded lines then add up to 2,613.50, while rounding only the total gives 2,613.51. The material does not say whether a write-up is converted together with the line or added after conversion; the assertions hold either way, but the defect only shows in the first case.
scenario: Create a proposal for projects.polarReporting with period end PERIOD_END and the invoice date left at the period end
Write up line 1 by 0.05 with the reason 'Rounding check'
Write up line 2 by 0.05 with the reason 'Rounding check'
Read the currency, the exchange rate and the line count
Read line 3's date, quantity and tax, and the amounts of lines 1, 2 and 3
Read the subtotal, the tax and the total
Accept the confirmation dialog and delete the proposal

checks.check: Line 3 tax on the rounded line
Subtotal as the sum of the printed lines
